alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a shaded timber lounge overlooking green vineyard rows. A blonde woman wearing a white mini with red Georgian-flag crosses hugs a seated braided woman in a plum vine-patterned dress from behind. Opposite them, a woman in an emerald top and copper skort reaches across to clasp hands. A fourth woman in a pearl-trimmed burgundy mini leans in from a higher bench. A scorpion tattoo is visible on the emerald-clad woman's upper arm.
